proposals: DPIIT should publish Industrial Entrepreneur Memorandum filings as a joint state-by-industry table, not only as separate state and industry totals, so which state won which sector can be confirmed from government data rather than from a news sweep.

DPIIT should include the reporting month in the state-wise IEM dataset on data.gov.in, so users can read the monthly series directly instead of deduplicating rows by keeping each state’s highest cumulative figure.
DPIIT should publish implemented IEM investment alongside intended investment, by state and sector, on the same dataset, so declared intent at registration is not read as capex actually made.

State industries departments, beginning with Maharashtra, Gujarat and Tamil Nadu, should publish a register of signed investment MoUs and groundbreakings with company, sector, district, date and the basis of the stated investment figure, so deal sizes reported as project cost, multi-year commitment or capacity can be compared.
